text: Lukas sat beside a scratched window as the train crossed its seventh hour of farmland and industrial towns. His reserved seat number matched the ticket tucked beneath his thumb. He planted himself outside the compartment and refused to move when the conductor returned.

text: On Sunday afternoon, Beatriz played midfield in an amateur football match on a muddy pitch behind the community hall. Instead, she backed away, jaw locked, and drove her next clearance hard enough to sting her foot.

text: Lukas sat beside a rain-streaked window as the overnight train crossed the mountains, twelve hours into its journey.
